method: Join source line to same A/Y/R code's airfield header, never to modern coordinates.
Match GROUP number and role and strictly normalized station name to separate USAF Maurer group-history OCR.
Cross-check month-range overlap with dated station-history candidate and next recorded station month. Same-month transitions remain ambiguous.
Expand month windows only through 1945-05; May is NOT known to end on May 9.
Flag header layout uncertainty, pre-header source lines, initial-operation/release-month conflicts, and unresolved dates.
Group and squadron entries are separate hierarchical records; do not add them to obtain counts of distinct aircraft or formations.
limitations: Both publications are official USAF histories but may share underlying records; matching is corroboration, NOT independent archival proof.
The historical code's field location is a candidate place name, not verified latitude/longitude or runway polygon.
Month-range overlap is not evidence of a full-month posting; no day-accurate moves are asserted.
A source mismatch can be caused by OCR, group headquarters vs detachments, different reporting conventions, or a genuine source disagreement.
Rows are not aircraft counts, not sortie counts, and not proof that combat missions were flown from the site.
No row is marked map-publication-ready; historical coordinates and original-page visual checks are still needed.
